claims.quote: High-resolution genetic and physical mapping has resulted in the identification of the Cacna2d2 gene encoding the alpha2delta2 voltage-dependent calcium channel subunit.

claims.object_text: ducky mouse model (absence epilepsy; spike-wave seizures and ataxia)
claims.quote: The mouse mutant ducky, a model for absence epilepsy, is characterized by spike-wave seizures and ataxia.
Both mutations are predicted to result in loss of the full-length alpha2delta2 protein.

claims.object_text: increases the maximum conductance of the alpha1A/beta4 channel combination
claims.quote: Functional analysis shows that the alpha2delta2 subunit increases the maximum conductance of the alpha1A/beta4 channel combination when coexpressed in vitro in Xenopus oocytes.

claims.object_text: reduced Ca(2+) channel current in du/du cerebellar Purkinje cells
claims.quote: The Ca(2+) channel current in acutely dissociated du/du cerebellar Purkinje cells was reduced, with no change in single-channel conductance.

claims.object_text: high expression in Purkinje but not granule neurons
claims.quote: high level of expression of the Cacna2d2 gene in Purkinje, but not granule, neurons.
